findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/CharP/Lemmas.lean:162 proves `add_pow_expChar`, Algebra.lean:119 provides `expChar_of_injective_algebraMap`, and Defs.lean:335 provides `expChar_ne_zero`; these replace every use of primality/`CharP` in lines 101–143.
findings.fix: State the general additive-group API under `[ExpChar R p]`, using `expChar_of_injective_algebraMap`, `add_pow_expChar`, and `expChar_ne_zero`; retain prime-characteristic assumptions only for the `AlphaP` specialization.
findings.issue: `frobeniusBialgHom` and its dependent API (`frobeniusBialgHom_ι`, `_ι_one`, `frobeniusEnd`, and `toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_frobeniusEnd`, lines 145–172) require `[Fact p.Prime] [CharP R p]`, although the power map is Frobenius whenever `[ExpChar R p]`.

summary: The additive-group Frobenius API is unnecessarily restricted to prime characteristic instead of Mathlib’s natural `ExpChar` abstraction.
